final: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, (SELECT AVG(li.product_price) FROM Invoice_Line_Items li WHERE li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number) AS mean_price, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items li WHERE li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number) AS n_items FROM Invoices i) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_invoice_mean_price, AVG(n_items) AS avg_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice
